火 is attested as a star name in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. The scanned 字源 passage tentatively calls it 火星 without specifying the precise star; the inspected interpretations identify it as 大火/心宿二. Why the star was named 火 is unresolved.

This star-name use is distinct from the literal sense ‘fire’. For 合集 11503, 字源 tentatively reads 火星 without specifying the precise star; inspected interpretations identify the historical name as 大火/心宿二. The evidence does not explain why the star was named 火 or how that name relates to ‘fire’.
